criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a real render on a dark field (mean mid tone 0.079). Six frames pass or nearly pass the showstopper test, three fail it. 01 about 7 (flat black windshield, plate brightest on the car). 02 about 7.5 (a true relief, 3x14 worn and 2x14 fresh, raked and casting). 03 about 5.5 (a tan board in the middle band, a featureless cylinder curb, thin cream ribbons, nothing fills a third). 04 about 6 (400 tan specks at 432 px, no pool, the close pair nearly merged). 05 about 7 (the roll call reads; a dead mid-tone kerb wedge top left, stair-step aliasing on the gutter lip, bars flat quads). 06 about 7 (the best composition; a mannequin-smooth kit person). 07 about 5.5 (bars read as tan planks 30 cm thick, a broad mid-tone band, no stop bar or kerb to scale it). 08 about 7 (72 grooves and the accent start bar; one large dim rectangle). 09 about 7.5 (the slab seated, county lines inlaid, League City's inlay the focal).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck on the contact sheet: near-black asphalt, bead-white thermoplastic, one terracotta accent on 6, 8 and 9, the same type band, no strobe. MOTIF_EVOLUTION does real work; CAMERA_MOVE reads 6 to 7. Frames 3 and 7 sit warmer and lighter; frame 1's purple-brown haze differs; VALUE_ARC real but soft.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide numeral traces (42, 70, $233,400, $899,600, 55, 400, six, two, 7/7/8 from vote rows, 72, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., the caption's 8 to 0). Looser spots: the 72-hour bagging and 'no second vote' rest on the Tribune while the resolution was read only for its title; frame 6's quote closes mid-question with no ellipsis; frame 9 and the caption give Harris County's hours though c25 places League City in Galveston County too.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Place, body, decision and date named; the stake lands across 6 to 8. The action step is weaker: only Harris County's hours, and the caption's closing question has no answer on any surface.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Frame 2 pays at once; frame 3 stalls as a correction frame; frame 4 a sideways detour; the turn 6 to 7 lands and 7 to 9 drives to the close. The cover announces rather than sets tension; frame 3 could fold into 2.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and local, no boosterism or doom. 'Drawn to illustrate.' closes eight deks; frame 3's 'Two kinds of number' is awkward; frame 5's dek is a run of fragments.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The technique is fresh (road paint as the counting material, no camera drawn). Palette and world are familiar across nos. 56 and 60 to 63. The subject is close to no. 39 on October 1st, and the close repeats a beat it carried; the cover echoes its road at blue hour.

hard_fails_note: A lead, not a hard fail: no. 39 on 2026-10-01, 30 days before, covered Flock plate readers and named League City's vote and the Kyle and Laredo May votes; its topic was the state funding pause, so no repeat inside the window was established.
one_sentence_fix: Re-shoot frames 7, 3 and 4 so each has one subject filling a third to two thirds of the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: At a 0.28 m eye the bars read as tan planks about 30 cm thick, a broad mid-tone band, no kerb, stop bar or figure for scale.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the camera to about 1.0 m at the kerb with the warning panel's edge and the stop bar in the near foreground; narrow the light so only the chamfers catch it and the tops fall dark.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A tan board across the middle band with a featureless cylinder curb; thin cream ribbons; brown mid tones; no subject fills a third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the concrete albedo near the asphalt's value and darken the curb so the bars and lit tick walls are the only bright values; dolly in, keeping a sliver of sky.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 400 evenly lit markers read as tan specks at 432 px with no pool; the six amber markers tiny, the close pair nearly merged.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the eye to about 1.2 m at fov 30 so the amber row stands in the near foreground at about three times a white marker's size; light a pool on the front rows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A dead mid-tone kerb wedge over the upper left third, stair-step aliasing on the gutter lip, bars flat quads.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swing the camera about 8 degrees right so the kerb slab leaves frame except its lit lip; give the bars a visible cast under the declared key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat black windshield, a primitive dark body, the plate the brightest object on the car.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Give the glass an environment reflection of the warm seam and drop the plate albedo to mid grey.
